Title: Street Trash Cleanup
Description: Clean up garbage from the downtown area.
Tasks: Go to warehouse
Grab supplies
Clean the streets
Empty trash at warehouse

Title: Grocery Delivery Run
Description: Run bags of groceries from the corner market to customers' doors before the ice cream melts.
Tasks: Pick up orders at the market
Load the delivery bike
Drop off at three apartments

Title: Diner Night Shift
Description: Work the graveyard shift at an all-night diner. Long hours, steady tips.
Tasks: Clock in and set up the counter
Take orders from the late crowd
Run plates from the kitchen
Bus and wipe down tables
Close out the register

Title: Warehouse Inventory
Description: Count, label and restock shipments at the riverside distribution warehouse. Needs someone with a little experience.
Tasks: Sign in with the shift supervisor
Unload the morning trucks
Scan and label every pallet
Restock the high shelves
Reconcile the count sheet

Title: Night Security Patrol
Description: Guard an office tower through the night. The building manager only hires established Workers.
Tasks: Collect keys and radio at the front desk
Check every door on the lower floors
Walk the parking garage
Review the camera feeds
Patrol the roof access
Write up the shift report

Title: Night Freight Sorting
Description: Work the overnight sort at the rail-side freight terminal, moving parcels off the late trains and onto the morning trucks. The terminal foreman only takes Workers with a few shifts behind them.
Tasks: Badge in at the terminal gate
Unload the cages from the late freight
Sort parcels by route on the conveyor
Re-tape and tag the damaged boxes
Stage the outbound pallets for the dawn trucks

Title: Fleet Maintenance Crew
Description: Join the night crew at the municipal garage, keeping the city's buses and delivery vans on the road. Greasy, skilled work, and the foreman won't hand you a wrench until you've proven yourself.
Tasks: Pull tonight's work orders from the foreman's board
Drain and change the oil on the bus line
Rotate the tires on the delivery vans
Replace the worn brake pads
Road-test the repaired vehicles around the yard
Log every repair in the maintenance book

Title: Municipal Records Contract
Description: City Hall is buried in paperwork. Spend a shift in the records basement sorting permits and scanning property deeds. Quiet, careful work that pays well, if the clerk trusts you with the files.
Tasks: Sign out the archive keys from the clerk
Haul the permit boxes up from the basement stacks
Sort a decade of building permits by district
Scan and index the property deeds
Flag the water-damaged files for restoration
Return the boxes and file the shift log

Title: Logistics Dispatch Coordinator
Description: Run the night desk at a regional trucking office, matching drivers, loads and routes across the whole city. The best contract a Worker can hold, and one step from a Professional's desk.
Tasks: Take over the desk from the evening dispatcher
Review the overnight load manifests
Assign a driver to every route
Reroute trucks around the bridge closure
Talk a stranded driver through a breakdown
Confirm deliveries with the warehouse leads
Hand the morning shift a clean board
